body.heading: Where in the world is Malawi?
paragraphs: Malawi is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Malawi is Lilongwe.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Malawi speak Nyanja and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Malawi is the Malawian kwacha.

body.heading: How big is Malawi?
paragraphs: Malawi covers about 118,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Ghana.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Malawi is so big it feels like an inland sea, with golden beaches, fishing villages and more kinds of colourful cichlid fish than any other lake on Earth.
Mount Mulanje rises in steep granite walls above tea fields. Hiking trails lead to waterfalls, rock pools and huts with huge views.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Malawi on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Malawi in one breath: a country in Eastern Africa, capital Lilongwe, where people speak Nyanja and pay with the Malawian kwacha.
